advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a regression test (AC4) for a container with a MIX of live, archived, AND deleted children asserting the signer-side fingerprint equals `attest.current_material_fingerprint()`, so the `deleted` branch of the shared predicate is exercised on the wide gate path.
evidence: `live_material_children` calls `_reads.list_tickets(parent=canonical_id, include_archived=True, repo_root=repo_root)` with no `exclude_deleted=True` (relation_snapshot.py:254), so deleted children rely on the predicate to be filtered
`list_tickets(..., exclude_deleted: bool = False, ...)` — default keeps deleted rows (src/rebar/_reads.py:87-88)
`counts_as_plan_material_child` returns `state.get("status") not in ("deleted", "archived")` — the `deleted` branch is load-bearing on the gate path (relation_snapshot.py:240)

Added `test_signer_and_gate_material_agree_across_archive` (test line 508-524) and `test_archived_child_excluded_from_child_ids_and_pins` (test line 532-542) create only live + archived children; neither creates a deleted child
Ticket b7a2 AC4: 'for a container with a mix of live, archived, and deleted children, the signer-side fingerprint and current_material_fingerprint() are equal' — no added test constructs this mix
advisory.finding: The new gate path `live_material_children` enumerates children with `include_archived=True` but not `exclude_deleted=True`, so deleted children are surfaced by the wide read and dropped ONLY by the `deleted` branch of `counts_as_plan_material_child` — yet no added test exercises a deleted child through `current_material_fingerprint`/`live_material_children`. The `deleted` half of the new predicate on the gate side is untested; a regression there (e.g. narrowing the predicate to exclude only `archived`) would not be caught. This is also exactly the scenario the ticket's AC4 calls for (a mix of live, archived, AND deleted children where signer == gate fingerprint), which the added tests do not cover.
scenarios: A future edit narrows `counts_as_plan_material_child` to exclude only `archived`, or the wide gate read starts including deleted children the signer omits — the signer/gate fingerprints diverge on a container with a deleted child and no test fails
advisory.suggested_fix: Extend `test_signer_and_gate_material_agree_across_archive` (or add a sibling) to also create and delete a child, then assert `signer() == gate()` with live + archived + deleted children present, matching ticket AC4.
